lines: Try not to tell any lies, as much as possible.
So that you can be gentle at all times.
When people feel pain,
let it feel as if it were your own.
Rightness replaced by another kind of rightness.
You will also encounter the sorrow of loss, though.
On a morning when the horizon shines, your hope collapses.
Someone whispers “beautiful” to the fragments blown by the wind.
Singing with a sad voice, it drifts to the sea and eventually shines.
You will see it.
Because you cannot see your own back.
Don’t be shy; ask others.
Because no one can see the heart.
Value what cannot be seen more than what can.
As each day piles upon the next,
people you can no longer meet will appear.
In a night so pale it seems transparent, one of your dreams comes true.
Amid cheers and applause, someone’s scream is hidden.
While searching for reasons to endure and holding many answers, you worry.
You will come to know yourself.
Even today, nothing remains in anyone’s heart nor is etched in sight.
Deep within the noise and footsteps, I am shouting “I am here.”
On a morning when the horizon shines, your hope collapses.
Someone whispers “beautiful” to the fragments blown by the wind.
Singing with a sad voice, it drifts to the sea and eventually shines.
You will see it.
You will see it.
